name: how-a-787-works
description: A scrolling pixel-art tour of the Boeing 787 and its systems, drawn by a Rust engine compiled to WASM.

scripts.wasm: cd engine && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p ../public && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/plane_engine.wasm ../public/engine.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && vercel deploy dist --prod --yes --project how-a-787-works --create-if-missing --scope ivanmartinez-8194s-projects
